cases.translation: Enter the ark with all your family.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: Enter the ark with all your family.
cases.explain: The preposition с (со) meaning 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Через семь дней я пошлю дождь на ___.
cases.translation: In seven days I will send rain upon the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition на expressing motion onto takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ной и его семья вошли в ковчег, чтобы спастись от ___.
cases.translation: Noah and his family entered the ark to be saved from the flood.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Все птицы пришли к ___ и вошли в ковчег парами.
cases.translation: All the birds came to Noah and entered the ark in pairs.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward/to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The waters lifted the ark high above the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition над (above) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: All the fountains of the great deep burst forth.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession ('the fountains of the deep').

cases.translation: The flood was on the earth forty days.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Когда воды потопа пришли на землю, Ною было 600 лет.
reading.question: How old was Noah when the floodwaters came upon the earth?
reading.explain: The text states Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.

reading.ru: Раскрылись окна неба, и дождь лил на землю сорок дней и сорок ночей.
reading.question: How long did the rain fall upon the earth?
reading.explain: The text says the rain fell on the earth for forty days and forty nights.

reading.ru: Ной, его сыновья, его жена и жены его сыновей вошли в ковчег, чтобы спастись от потопа.
reading.question: Why did Noah and his family enter the ark?
options: To save themselves from the flood
reading.correct: To save themselves from the flood
reading.explain: The text says they entered the ark in order to be saved from the flood.

reading.ru: И тогда Господь затворил за ним дверь.
reading.question: Who shut the door behind Noah?
reading.explain: The text says the Lord shut the door behind him.

reading.ru: Потоп набирал силу на земле 150 дней.
reading.question: For how many days did the flood prevail upon the earth?
reading.explain: The text states the flood gained strength on the earth for 150 days.

reading.ru: Остался только Ной и те, кто были с ним в ковчеге.
reading.question: Who remained alive after every living thing was destroyed?
options: Only Noah and those with him in the ark
reading.correct: Only Noah and those with him in the ark
reading.explain: The text says only Noah and those who were with him in the ark were left.
